desc: A popular probing kick. Depending on how White responds, Black either gets to close White in, or extend on the upper side and later threaten a ko. See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 23, Kim Junghyun 6p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H8Oehpm4Rho&t=180s).
